name: minecraft-seed-tools
description: Chunkbase-style Minecraft Seed Map and Seed Finder (Java + Bedrock) with a shared WASM/native generation engine

scripts.gen:golden: cmake -S . -B build/native >/dev/null && cmake --build build/native --target golden_dump >/dev/null && ./build/native/golden_dump tests/golden/worlds.bin
scripts.test: npm run build:native && npm run test:native && npm run build:wasm && npm run test:wasm && npm run test:finder && npm run test:versions && npm run test:golden && npm run test:interface && npm run test:android
